dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single high-contrast white band across the greater coverts, appearing as a thick, sharp horizontal block against dark grey-black plumage.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent; pale bluish-white edges provide high-contrast boundaries against the dark centers of the folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, distinct ovoid white spot located centrally at the transition between the posterior crown and upper mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear boundary separating the black crown from the greenish-grey mantle, interrupted only by the central nape spot.
